Questions.What is difference between satellite int: What is difference between satellite internet and wireless internet?
Questions.Satellite internet: Satellite internet relies on direct satellite connections, such as services like Starlink, which are currently unlicensed and not officially available in Syria. Our wireless internet service, however, is licensed through the Telecommunications Establishment and works by connecting your device to the main fiber optic tower using an external dish, providing a stable and reliable connection.
Questions.Is the package speed the same as the dow: Is the package speed the same as the download speed?
Questions.No: No. Actual download speed is calculated by dividing the package speed by 8. For example, a 10 Mbps package provides an approximate download speed of 1.25 Mbps. The upload speed equals the download speed.
Questions.Can I change the package speed at any ti: Can I change the package speed at any time?
Questions.You can: Yes. You can upgrade or change the package speed at any time, and the price difference is calculated based on the number of days remaining in your current subscription.
